svg.title: Six threshold estimators on one latent-observed pair
svg.desc: Curves and estimator markers compare exact raw spanning, the frozen pond-fraction baseline, the fractal breakpoint, Euler/Betti, persistence-pruned Betti, and the positive-EDT throat on the same representative pair.
